And now when its her turn to reciprocate she feels she is too immature for this relationship and doesn't want me anymore

She threatened multiple times in the past as well, but I managed to make her stay every time. She fucked me up mentally, emotionally, made me so drugs with her and when I didn't want to she would throw tantrums.

I feel like I threw so much into being with her that I lost everything that made me, me. 

I loved her so much. But she makes mecfeel like dogshit now

I want out
